_doc: What drifts in the air (docs/modules/lands.md, dev.awaken.terrain.client.AirTable). Rules are tried in order, first match wins; any assets/<ns>/lands/air*.json is read, later files' rules first. leaves: by block id or #block tag. sprites: falling_leaf_<n> indices; size: x a leaf's usual size; rate: x the spawn rate; color: a fixed colour instead of the block's tint and texture. biomes: by biome id, #biome tag or *. rate 0 = nothing falls there; color + colorMix tint every leaf in that biome; motes: glowing motes rising (night: only at night).

leaves._why: the Lumen Forest's air is motes
